## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and why this change helps.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain failed or skipped checks. For interface changes, include desktop 1440px and mobile 390px screenshots and console-error results. For detection changes, include synthetic evaluation results and any benign regressions.

## Privacy and compatibility

Describe changes to permissions, stored data, network requests, consent, rule versions, dependencies, or deployment requirements. Write "None" when applicable.

- [ ] The change has focused scope and relevant documentation.
- [ ] Examples, logs, screenshots, and fixtures contain no real credentials or private addresses.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or remaining failures and limitations are explained above.
